case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

You wrote that your family foundry takes pride in supplying us and values our long relationship, and we feel the same. We also remember that you held the old price for us in a hard year, and we want a fair solution for both family companies.

Here is how we see your offer, point by point.

On the notice period:
Your letter of 11 September 2026 (doc:20260911-70110-P01) gives 51 days' notice, while our contract (ctr:4600070110) requires 90 days.

On quality:
Your quality was 712 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70110@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Volute casing HN 50-200 with you were placed at EUR 128.42 on 2024-10-04 (po:4500011493-10), EUR 128.27 on 2025-06-03 (po:4500012541-10), EUR 126.53 on 2026-01-16 (po:4500013434-10) and EUR 126.53 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014428-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 131.59; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 132.47; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 133.35; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.

Option A is the package we can approve. It reflects the stable price history and the quality you deliver, and it gives you a clear, reliable basis for the coming years.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We also checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point.

Our offer stands at a price of €138.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. To honor our long-standing partnership, we accept your proposed effective date of 2027-04-01 and 30-day payment terms. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €136.50 per unit, valid from 1 April 2027.

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Quality Manager: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

You wrote that the notice period was a fair point, and we appreciate that. It shows the same straightforwardness we have known from your family firm for many years.

Your latest offer still sits well above what we can approve. Our options below move in the direction you care about: Option A pays you faster, on shorter terms, and at a price that is fair for both family companies. Beyond that we see no room for a higher price.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 131.87; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 132.61; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 133.35; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.

Option A is the package we can approve, because it gives your foundry the quickest payment and a clear, stable price from the new start date.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. You held the old price for us in a hard year, and we have not forgotten it. This is how we want to answer that loyalty, with reliable and prompt payment.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

We take great pride in our work and the dedicated team here in the region, and we hope we can find a good way forward together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
